name: blender-mcp
description: Control Blender via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Provides tools for 3D modeling, scene inspection, material manipulation, asset downloads, and code execution in Blender.
author: OpenClaw Community

quick_start: 1. Install Blender MCP Python package: `pip install blender-mcp` or use `uvx blender-mcp`
2. Install the Blender addon from `assets/addon.py` into Blender (Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install)
3. Enable the addon and click 'Connect to Claude' in the BlenderMCP sidebar
4. Start the MCP server: `uvx blender-mcp` (keep it running)
5. Configure mcporter to connect to the server (typically as 'blender')
6. Use in OpenClaw: `from blender_mcp_client import BlenderMCPClient`
